key_highlights: ASX records fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities across sectors
AUD enters 'trapdoor' phase, weakening sharply against USD amid global risk-off sentiment
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite a sharp unemployment jump, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline, pressuring REITs and bank NIMs
Gold exploration sector sees multiple high-grade hits (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 in WA), supporting junior miners
$2.7B cap raise wave keeps ASX small-cap brokers under pressure, signalling capital market stress
Data centre boom flagged as potential 'energy bust' risk for Australian power grid and energy names
Star Group's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming sector sentiment

sectors.trend: Gold juniors outperform on strong exploration results (Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko); broader materials under pressure from falling commodity demand signals and AUD weakness
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and juniors (ANX.AX, MPM.AX, MRX.AX) offer relative strength; iron ore names (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face headwinds from China demand concerns and AUD depreciation

sectors.trend: RBA hiking cycle continues despite unemployment spike; house price declines threaten NIMs and credit quality; renter stress (50%+ struggling) signals rising NPL risk
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression from rate pincer; defensive positioning warranted; watch credit loss provisions

sectors.trend: Largest house price falls in 40 years underway; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m; property sector in structural correction
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) under pressure from falling valuations and rising vacancy; avoid until stabilisation confirmed

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating energy demand surge but flagged as 'energy bust' risk; AI data centre development proceeding without permits signals regulatory gaps
sectors.implications: Energy names (SME.AX, WES.AX, AGL.AX) benefit from demand but face grid capacity constraints; infrastructure plays (WTC.AX, CGW.AX) see long-term tailwinds

sectors.trend: Card surcharge removal reshapes retail payments; Star casino licence suspended; consumer squeeze from interest rate pincer and renter stress
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure; Star Group (SGH.AX) remains impaired; consumer staples defensive but growth limited

sectors.trend: $2.7B cap raise wave signals capital hunger; ASX small-cap runners (Micro-X, Arrow Minerals, Mamba) show momentum; global AI chip trade (Nvidia, AMD, Intel) provides thematic backdrop
sectors.implications: High-risk small-cap environment; cap raises dilute existing holders; AI/tech exposure via global names rather than ASX-listed

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot despite deteriorating labour market creates stagflation risk
AUD weakness amplifies import costs and pressures commodity exporters' AUD revenue
Property correction in advanced stage (40-year high decline) with spillover to banks and REITs
Gold exploration renaissance in WA and West Africa supports junior miners
Data centre energy demand creates structural tailwind for Australian power generators
Small-cap cap raise overhang ($2.7B) signals liquidity stress in ASX 200/300 periphery
Geopolitical risk (China-US tensions, Trump regime change signals) elevates safe-haven flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hikes amid rising unemployment (stagflation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce cyclical equity exposure; hedge with AUD put options
Hedge foreign currency exposure; favour AUD-denominated income; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property correction spilling into bank credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce bank weight; monitor NPL trends; favour diversified lenders (CBA.AX) over regional exposure
Avoid pre-announcement small-cap positions; favour ASX 100 liquidity; set stop-losses
Maintain 10-15% gold allocation; diversify geographically; monitor iron ore/coal export exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy grid strain from data centre boom
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO capacity warnings; favour generators with contracted offtake; avoid unpermitted project exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and explorers on strong exploration results and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 hits, Vista Gold M&A activity signal sector re-rating; AUD weakness boosts gold in AUD terms

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Australian power generators benefiting from data centre energy demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural energy demand from AI/data centres supports long-term contracted revenue for generators

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on ASX 200 gold and energy names as relative outperformers in risk-off tape
opportunities.rationale: Fourth losing week for broad index but gold/energy show resilience; rotation into defensives

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property exposure; avoid new property-linked positions
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline in progress; CBD commercial listings at distressed levels; renter stress rising

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure or hedge with short-duration bond overlay
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hiking into unemployment spike compresses NIMs; rising NPLs from renter stress threaten credit costs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid ASX small-cap cap raise candidates; maintain liquidity buffer
defensive_moves.rationale: $2.7B cap raise wave signals dilution risk; brokers under pressure; liquidity events may trigger further selling

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure; consider 10-15% gold allocation as currency hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' open; depreciation amplifies import inflation and pressures equity valuations

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Fourth consecutive losing week with rising bond yields, AUD weakness, and RBA hawkishness create a negative feedback loop. Expect further ASX 200 downside toward psychological support. Gold and energy relative outperformance likely to continue. Small-cap cap raises may trigger episodic volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on select sectors. Property correction nearing completion (over halfway through 40-year decline) suggests eventual stabilisation. Data centre energy demand provides multi-year structural tailwind for generators. Gold exploration pipeline supports junior miner pipeline. However, stagflation risk from RBA policy misalignment caps upside for broad equities.
key_catalysts: Next RBA board decision and cash rate guidance
Australian CPI and unemployment data release
Iron ore and LNG price trajectory (China demand signals)
ASX small-cap cap raise completion and market absorption
US-China geopolitical developments (Trump regime change signals)
AEMO energy demand forecasts from data centre buildout
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
